instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. Use only supplied observations and knowledge. Do not calculate or set emotion.

latestAttribution.cause: The active squad eliminated the enemy squad before losing any member, producing the observed win.
alternativeCauses: The encounter may have posed a low enough physical threat that the starting squad composition was not decisive.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the obtained gear and compare survival and completion against the next available main encounter.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the common gloves on the warrior increased equipped power from 0 to 32.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter and observe whether the equipped warrior retains strong combat contribution.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the common charm on the healer increased total equipped power from 32 to 52.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter and observe healer contribution and squad survival.

latestAttribution.cause: The cleared encounter produced a character unlock for the mage.
Equipping the item increased the hero's power from 52 to 87, a gain of 35.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip a different item and check whether the observed power changes by its reported power delta.

latestAttribution.cause: The player explicitly replaced the Spear Militia with the newly unlocked Mage, changing the active team while equipped power stayed at 87.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Use the changed team in Main 3 and compare the Mage's visible contribution.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the Main 2 weapon on the Warrior increased equipped power by 28.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge Main 3 with the equipped weapon and changed team.

latestAttribution.cause: After the player manually selected the Mage, the Mage dealt 62.04% of team damage and ranked first in Main 3, confirming the team-change hypothesis.
alternativeCauses: The newly equipped Warrior weapon also contributed to the overall win.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Keep the Mage active for the next mixed encounter and compare whether its damage lead persists.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the Lv.7 chest on the Barricade Militia raised equipped power from 115 to 149.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Finish preparing the active squad, then attempt the visible Prison rescue.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the Lv.4 boots on the Warrior increased equipped power from 149 to 175.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Attempt the visible Prison rescue with the fully prepared inventory.

latestAttribution.cause: The Prison remained unsolved after a 36.6% equipped-power gain; the entire squad died with three enemies remaining, refuting ordinary Main 4 gear as a sufficient key.
alternativeCauses: The Prison may require a more targeted preparation source rather than another small generic power increase.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Advance through Main 5 and inspect any newly exposed branch or targeted reward before another retry.

latestAttribution.cause: Clearing Main 4 produced two new equipment items, confirming that progressing can create preparation options, but equipped power stayed at 175 until the player equips them.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip useful Main 4 drops and compare the new power against the Prison failure baseline.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the Lv.7 helm on the Warrior raised equipped power from 175 to 207.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the remaining useful item and reassess the Prison retry threshold.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the remaining boots on the Barricade Militia raised equipped power from 207 to 239, now 36.6% above the Prison failure baseline.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Compare the now-woken Prison retry against continuing to Main 5.

latestAttribution.cause: Clearing Main 5 unlocked both Main 6 and a new Bandit Camp branch, confirming the search for a qualitatively new preparation option.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Inspect the Bandit Camp's visible reward and compare it with ordinary Main 5 drops before choosing the next action.

latestAttribution.cause: Clearing the Bandit Camp produced the promised rare shield-breaking and armor-breaking equipment, plus a rare Ranger bow, while equipped power stayed unchanged until explicit equipment decisions.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the targeted Camp gear on suitable active units, then retry the Prison.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly replacing the ordinary weapon with the rare shield-breaking axe raised equipped power by 106 and added the targeted break property.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the matching armor-breaking gloves before retrying the Prison.
